question: Who must sign the Authority to Release Personal Information form?

claims.text: The IMM 5475 form must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual.
claims.quote: The [IMM 5475 form (PDF, 593.57 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5475e.pdf) must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual.

basis: The applicant submitted an Authority to Release Personal Information form (IMM 5475) for opaque case ID 3dac93470c38cd92756a9ed787f164f6.
Document instance field evaluation for case 3dac93470c38cd92756a9ed787f164f6 reveals a defect in the Signature & Date Check: both signature_date and section_c_date are N/A (blank and undated).
Because valid YYYY-MM-DD dates are required for signature_date and section_c_date, the undated signature renders the Authority to Release Personal Information form defective (PFL-AUTHORIT-01).
